title: Compared to Trabeculectomy, Ex-Press® Surgery Significantly Decreased the Loss of Corneal Endothelial Cell Density in Low-Intraocular-Pressure Glaucoma: 3-Year Follow-Up

license.statement: Dove Medical Press terms incorporating CC BY-NC 3.0 unported (article <license>); not CC BY, record kept private

indication: Primary open-angle glaucoma with preoperative IOP of 21 mmHg or less under medication (low-IOP glaucoma), first filtration surgery with mitomycin C by one surgeon; simultaneous phacoemulsification in 24/39 trabeculectomy and 15/36 Ex-Press eyes; prior cataract surgery, trabeculotomy, SLT or vitrectomy allowed; pseudoexfoliation and secondary glaucoma excluded

groups.description: Trabeculectomy with MMC (operated May 2018 to January 2020), 39 eyes of 36 patients
Ex-Press P50 shunt under a scleral flap with MMC (operated May 2013 to April 2018), 36 eyes of 34 patients

series.baseline_label: Preoperative central CED (Tomey EM-3000) of the operated eye, Table 1 'Preoperative CED' for the Trab group
series.notes: Follow-up means from Table 4 (12, 24, 36 mos CED, mean ± SD); the reference cites Table 1 R7C2 because Table 4 R2C2 gives a conflicting duplicate (see record notes)

series.baseline_label: Preoperative central CED (Tomey EM-3000) of the operated eye, Table 4 'Preoperative CED' for the EXP group (identical to Table 1 R7C3)
series.notes: Table 4 EXP column, mean ± SD at preoperative, 12, 24 and 36 months

exclusions.what: t0004 R2C2 (trabeculectomy preoperative CED in Table 4)
exclusions.reason: conflicts with Table 1 R7C2 and with the Abstract for the same group and statistic (one digit of the mean differs; SD and p-value identical); the Table 1 cell, which agrees with the Abstract, is cited as the reference
ratio of postoperative to preoperative CED (%), not an admissible value kind; the absolute CED series of the same groups is used

exclusions.what: t0005 survival ratios by glaucoma surgery alone vs simultaneous cataract surgery
exclusions.reason: ratios only, without a reference ECD per subgroup; subgroups nested within the arms

exclusions.what: t0004 C4 and t0001 C4 p-values

notes: Retrospective single-centre comparison of two established filtration surgeries performed in different calendar periods; neither arm is declared experimental, so both are recorded as control (procedure context glaucoma, with simultaneous cataract surgery in part of each arm).

CED was measured once preoperatively and every 12 months postoperatively; all eyes were followed for more than 3 years; tables give no per-visit n. Binocular data were used for patients operated in both eyes.
The Abstract's 3-year survival ratio for the Trab group also differs from Table 4; not used.
